item.description:
# Doppel 2.0.1
- Fixes ChatGPT updates that left Personal and Veridue stuck on the old build. ChatGPT 26.1016 changed how it reports its OAuth callback, and Doppel could not patch it. - Doppel now tests a new ChatGPT build against its patcher before closing or replacing anything. If the build is not compatible yet, the update stops with a clear message and your current apps keep working. - After updating Doppel, run the ChatGPT update again from the Doppel menu if you are still on 26.1013.

# Doppel 2.0.0
- Set up iPhone Codex access from each profile's new Remote Access window. Keep Personal and Work as separate phone connections with independently signed-in accounts and managed runtimes. - Choose your existing LAN or private network, including Meshnet. Doppel supplies the connection details and an iPhone-compatible PEM key without enabling macOS Remote Login. - Confirm the live remote account and workspace before enabling access. Replace a phone key, update one remote runtime, or switch accounts while access is disabled. Disabling access revokes the phone key before closing open sessions; you can enable it again without signing in again. - Choose Receive Beta Updates in the Doppel menu to switch update channels. Your selection persists after updating; switching off waits for a newer stable release. - Cloned apps now launch on their pinned Dock icon, and automatic startup repair preserves the app directory. Rebuild each existing instance once after updating Doppel to install the updated launcher.
Remote tasks use the Mac user's filesystem permissions. The Mac must remain awake and logged in. Desktop history, Browser, Computer Use and cloud synchronization are outside this release.

item.title: 2.0.0-beta-5
item.description:
# Doppel 2.0.0-beta-5
- Fixes clone rebuilds on ChatGPT 26.1013. That build changed how it hands deep links to the app, so Doppel could not patch the OAuth callback routing and every instance failed to start with "Patching the instance OAuth callback routing failed".
Includes [PR #56](https://github.com/thomast8/doppel/pull/56).
This remains a beta. Remote Access requires the Mac to stay awake and logged in. Menu-click and physical-keypad reconnection QA remain incomplete, and macOS 14 execution, logout/login recovery, and network-loss recovery still need broader testing.
